entities.summary: Tomohisa Yamashita (b. 1985-04-09, Funabashi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Funabashi and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
